model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across nine language family categories for six different model-metric combinations. The horizontal axis represents language family categories labeled IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family group contains up to six bars corresponding to six model variants shown in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/rose), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Each bar includes error bars (black vertical lines with caps) indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all bars are relatively short, ranging from approximately 1 to 6. IE-Germanic shows moderate values, with mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near 10, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ around 10, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ approximately 15. IE-Indic displays some of the tallest bars, with XLM-L₂ and mBERT-R₂ reaching approximately 21, XLM-R₂ around 18, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ near 21, while mBERT-L₂ is close to 0; this group also has notably large error bars extending up to about 30. IE-Romance shows values around 6 for the L₂ variants, approximately 13 for mBERT-R₂, around 5–6 for XLM-R₂ and XLM-B₂, and about 6 for mBERT-B₂. IE-Slavic has bars ranging from approximately 1 (XLM-R₂) to about 10 (mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂), with mBERT-B₂ near 9. IE-other shows values from near 0 (XLM-R₂) up to approximately 17 (mBERT-B₂), with large error bars. Isolate has very small bars, all near 0–1, except mBERT-B₂ at approximately 8. Semitic displays tall bars, with XLM-L₂ around 11, mBERT-R₂ near 16, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ approximately 19 and 15 respectively, accompanied by large error bars. Uralic shows mostly small values near 0–1, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 15 and XLM-B₂ around 5. The bars within each group are arranged in the consistent order matching the legend from left to right, and no particular sorting pattern is applied to the category order along the horizontal axis. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the standard color coding.
